Data science is an interdisciplinary field that uses scientific methods, statistics, programming, and domain knowledge to extract useful information from data.

Python is widely used in data science because it provides libraries such as Pandas for data manipulation, NumPy for numerical operations, and Matplotlib for data visualization.

Data scientists use machine learning techniques to identify patterns, make predictions, and discover relationships in large datasets. Common applications include customer segmentation, sales forecasting, fraud detection, and business intelligence.

Data analysis involves inspecting, cleaning, transforming, and interpreting information. The goal is to discover useful insights that support better decisions.

Data visualization helps communicate findings through charts, graphs, and dashboards. Tools such as Matplotlib, Seaborn, and Power BI are commonly used to present analytical results.
